t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The previous participant recommends choosing colors (purple, orange, green, and one other) over just randomly selecting the gnomes.

vb_textbox.text: I recommend selecting "s" for 1x and "k" for x5 in the first round. I stuck with orange, yellow, green, and brown gnomes and avoided red, pink, and blue gnomes. I had pretty good luck with the yellow gnome in the third and fourth rounds.
